name: Knowledge Completion
scope: Case-derived Knowledge gap draft outline for review; no article publication or claim of corpus completeness.

requirements.acceptance: The model distinguishes absent knowledge from unsupported tasks.
requirements.coverage: Native Case Subject/Reason produces question/category hypothesis for Knowledge owner review.

requirements.acceptance: Questions cite the specific scenarios and evidence gap they address.
requirements.coverage: Case-based draft question cites a scoped Case record reference and category hypothesis.
requirements.blocker: Scenario-specific evidence gaps and authoritative Knowledge corpus access not implemented.

requirements.acceptance: Ranking is compared with frequency-first and manual baselines.
requirements.coverage: No automatic question ranking claimed; outlines preserve source Case links for manual review.
requirements.blocker: Frequency-first/manual benchmark and question prioritization not implemented.

requirements.acceptance: A proposed model answer cannot publish itself as authoritative policy.
requirements.coverage: Invocable returns draft-only outline; no generated answer, Knowledge DML or publication path.
requirements.blocker: Approved-answer capture and authenticated Knowledge-owner workflow absent.

requirements.acceptance: Benefits reflect newly resolvable work rather than number of articles created.
requirements.coverage: Native tests specify draft state, no DML and unknown Case.
requirements.blocker: Independent knowledge owner/user validation and downstream outcome comparison absent.

blockers: Scoped metadata compilation and unit tests passed; broader integration, denied-user scenarios, actual domain policies and independent evaluation remain incomplete.
Original acceptance requirements remain partial; owner validation, comparative benchmarks and independent evidence pending.
commands: sf project deploy start --dry-run --target-org eb1a-dev --manifest manifest/package.xml --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests KnowledgeGapDraftActionTest

native_validation.scope: one Developer org; scoped unit tests and supplied metadata only
